item: Current Stage 3 dark-fraction value and band
notes: The row explains rotating-body illumination geometry and a site-dependent band but names no external source.
Marks NEED BACKING; displays the Vesta tropical comparator, labels 0.50 scenario geometry, says no source sets the generic range, and points to rc-413.
The solar disk is typically seen about half the time in Vesta’s tropics; this is a Vesta comparator, not a generic asteroid-site range.
Reported Vesta locations differ; this range does not establish the economicspace [0.35, 0.55] band for generic asteroid sites.
